# Charly Vibes

> A field of experimentation for LLM-assisted development. All code is generated by large language models; the human contribution lies in requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Charly Vibes explores what software development looks like when the machine writes and the human decides. Nine projects spanning CLI tools, SPAs, blogs, and desktop applications — all built through dialogue with AI.

## Projects

- [microdancing](https://charly-vibes.github.io/microdancing/llms.txt): Blog of microposts and minimal chronicles. Home of the Resonant Coding manifesto.
- [nayra](https://charly-vibes.github.io/nayra/llms.txt): Deep-time timeline visualization. 10,000+ events at 60 FPS, microseconds to billions of years.
- [jams](https://charly-vibes.github.io/jams/llms.txt): Small apps, one-day experiments, for understanding tools directly and almost brutally.
- [fabbro](https://charly-vibes.github.io/fabbro/llms.txt): CLI for reviewing and annotating LLM-generated code. Structured annotations, local-first.
- [wai](https://charly-vibes.github.io/wai/llms.txt): Workflow manager for AI-assisted development. Organizes research, plans, and design decisions.
- [fotos](https://charly-vibes.github.io/fotos/llms.txt): Screenshot tool with OCR, PII detection, and MCP server for code agent integration.
- [incitaciones](https://charly-vibes.github.io/incitaciones/llms.txt): Reusable prompts and skills for CLI LLM tools (Claude Code, Amp, Gemini CLI, Cursor).
- [rizomas](https://charly-vibes.github.io/rizomas/llms.txt): Rhizomatic interactive essays on how LLMs work.
- [bichos](https://github.com/charly-vibes/bichos): Biomimetic framework for autonomous QA — swarms of specialized agents coordinated by stigmergy. Proposal stage.

## Authorship

All code in this organization was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review. The LLM writes. The human knows what it should say.

- [Authorship note](https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/): Full statement in Spanish on LLM authorship and human role.
